text:
Predicates:
Flys(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Flys(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
¬(Flys(susan, y) ∧ y = lga) ::: The departure and arrival cannot be the same airport.
Flys(john, lga) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
Flys(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
